SELECT sc.signalref, sc.sigclasstype, sp.techsigprob, sp.natsrcprob, sp.artsrcprob 
FROM signalclassification sc 
JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON sc.signalref = sp.signalref 
WHERE sc.sigclasstype = 'Candidate'
LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signalclassification WHERE sigclasstype = 'Candidate'

-- Check BFR values for candidates to see if threshold makes sense
SELECT sc.signalref, s.bwhz, s.centerfreqmhz, 
       CASE WHEN s.centerfreqmhz > 0 THEN s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000.0) ELSE NULL END as bfr
FROM signalclassification sc
JOIN signals s ON sc.signalref = s.signalregistry
WHERE sc.sigclasstype = 'Candidate'
ORDER BY bfr
LIMIT 10

-- Test: How many candidates meet the technosignature thresholds?
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_candidates,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sp.techsigprob > 0.7 AND sp.natsrcprob < 0.3 AND sp.artsrcprob < 50 
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as meets_thresholds
FROM signalclassification sc
JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON sc.signalref = sp.signalref
WHERE sc.sigclasstype = 'Candidate'

-- Check what columns have reasonable values for "origin score"
SELECT sp.techsigprob, sp.natsrcprob, sp.artsrcprob, sp.sigunique, sp.simindex, sp.corrscore, sp.falseposprob, sp.anomscore
FROM signalprobabilities sp
JOIN signalclassification sc ON sc.signalref = sp.signalref
WHERE sc.sigclasstype = 'Candidate'
LIMIT 5

-- Build the full query to verify it works
SELECT 
    o.observstation,
    COUNT(*) as candidate_count,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(sp.techsigprob) AS numeric), 4) as avg_origin_score,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000.0)) AS numeric), 10) as avg_frequency_ratio,
    ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS numeric), 2) as pct_of_all_candidates
FROM signalclassification sc
JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON sc.signalref = sp.signalref
JOIN signals s ON sc.signalref = s.signalregistry
JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
WHERE sc.sigclasstype = 'Candidate'
  AND sp.techsigprob > 0.7
  AND sp.natsrcprob < 0.3
  AND sp.artsrcprob < 50
GROUP BY o.observstation
ORDER BY candidate_count DESC

JOIN signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
JOIN signaladvancedphenomena sa ON s.signalregistry = sa.signalref
WHERE sa.encryptevid = 'Strong'

JOIN researchprocess rp ON s.signalregistry = rp.signalref

-- Maybe "origin score" = techsigprob, "frequency ratio" = bwhz/centerfreqmhz (not freqmhz)
-- And percentage should use total matching signals as denominator
SELECT 
    o.observstation,
    COUNT(*) as signal_count,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(sp.techsigprob) AS numeric), 4) as avg_origin_score,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(s.bwhz / s.centerfreqmhz) AS numeric), 10) as avg_frequency_ratio,
    ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS numeric), 2) as pct_of_all_candidates
FROM telescopes t
JOIN signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
WHERE sp.techsigprob > 0.7 AND sp.natsrcprob < 0.3
GROUP BY o.observstation
ORDER BY signal_count DESC, o.observstation ASC
LIMIT 5
